author: Priya Raman
text: We cut onboarding from 14 days to 3. Killed the 40-field signup form down to 4, moved KYC async, dropped manual review under $5k. Activation went 31% to 58% in Q2. Support tickets fell 22%.

author: Priya Raman
text: Success is not an accident. It is a mindset. Keep showing up even when nobody claps. Consistency beats talent every single time.

author: Dev Arora
text: Unpopular opinion: most B2B demos should be 12 minutes, not 45. We tested both across 214 calls last quarter. The 12-minute version closed at 31% versus 19%, and the no-show rate on follow-ups halved.
